package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func (repository *validationRepositoryFake) GetInstance(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID string) (domain.TaskInstance, error) {
	if repository.instance.ID != instanceID || repository.instance.StudentID != studentID {
		return domain.TaskInstance{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return repository.instance, nil
}

func teacherFeedbackFixture(outcome domain.ValidationOutcome, stages []domain.ValidationStage) (*Runtime, *validationRepositoryFake) {
	instance, submission, pending := validationFixtures()
	instance.CurrentStep = &instance.Steps[0]
	submission.UpdatedAt = time.Date(2026, 10, 4, 1, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	result := validationResultFor(instance, submission, pending.RunID)
	result.Outcome, result.Stages = outcome, stages
	run := &submission.ValidationRuns[0]
	run.Outcome = outcome
	switch outcome {
	case domain.OutcomePass:
		run.Status = domain.ValidationRunPassed
	case domain.OutcomeFail:
		run.Status = domain.ValidationRunFailed
	case domain.OutcomeError:
		run.Status = domain.ValidationRunError
		result.ErrorClassification = "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE"
		run.ErrorClassification = result.ErrorClassification
	}
	run.SafeSummary = domain.NewSafeValidationSummary(run.ID, result)
	repository := &validationRepositoryFake{instance: instance, submission: submission}
	return &Runtime{Repository: repository}, repository
}

func TestTeacherSafeFeedbackUsesStrictEnvelopeUniqueBoundedRequiredIssues(t *testing.T) {
	stages := []domain.ValidationStage{{StageID: "optional", Required: false, Outcome: "FAIL", Issues: []domain.ValidationIssue{{Code: "OPTIONAL_ISSUE", Message: "PRIVATE_CANARY"}}}}
	stage := domain.ValidationStage{StageID: "html", Required: true, Outcome: "FAIL"}
	for index := 0; index < 8; index++ {
		issue := domain.ValidationIssue{Code: fmt.Sprintf("MISSING_%d", index), Message: "PRIVATE_CANARY <script>solution</script>"}
		stage.Issues = append(stage.Issues, issue, issue)
	}
	stages = append(stages, stage)
	runtime, repository := teacherFeedbackFixture(domain.OutcomeFail, stages)
	result, err := runtime.TeacherValidation(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, repository.instance.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if result.Schema != "practice-task-teacher-validation-context.v1" || !result.Available || result.Passed == nil || *result.Passed || result.SubmissionID == nil || *result.SubmissionID != repository.submission.ID || result.WorkspaceDigest == nil || *result.WorkspaceDigest != repository.submission.WorkspaceDigest || result.UpdatedAt == nil || !result.UpdatedAt.Equal(repository.submission.UpdatedAt) {
		t.Fatalf("wrong Teacher correlation: %+v", result)
	}
	explanation := result.TeacherExplanation
	if explanation == nil || explanation.Schema != "teacher-validation-explanation.v1" || len(explanation.BlockingIssues) != 5 || !explanation.Truncated || !strings.HasPrefix(explanation.SourceDigest, "sha256:") {
		t.Fatalf("wrong bounded explanation: %+v", explanation)
	}
	for index, issue := range explanation.BlockingIssues {
		if issue.Code != fmt.Sprintf("MISSING_%d", index) || issue.StageID != "html" || issue.Message != domain.SafeSemanticIssueMessage {
			t.Fatalf("wrong required semantic issue: %+v", issue)
		}
	}
	encoded, _ := json.Marshal(result)
	for _, private := range []string{"PRIVATE_CANARY", "script", "safe_summary", "snapshot_id", "sandbox_id", "validation_specification"} {
		if strings.Contains(string(encoded), private) {
			t.Fatalf("unsafe Teacher field/content: %s", encoded)
		}
	}
	repeated, err := runtime.TeacherValidation(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, repository.instance.StudentID)
	if err != nil || repeated.TeacherExplanation.SourceDigest != explanation.SourceDigest {
		t.Fatal("source digest changed without safe content change")
	}
	repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0].SafeSummary.Stages[1].Issues[0].Code = "CHANGED"
	changed, _ := runtime.TeacherValidation(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, repository.instance.StudentID)
	if changed.TeacherExplanation.SourceDigest == explanation.SourceDigest {
		t.Fatal("source digest did not bind safe content")
	}
	contextResult, err := runtime.TeacherContext(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, repository.instance.StudentID)
	if err != nil || !contextResult.Validation.Available || contextResult.Validation.Passed || contextResult.Validation.StageCount != 2 || contextResult.Validation.ErrorCount != 17 {
		t.Fatalf("Teacher counts not derived from safe current result: %+v %v", contextResult.Validation, err)
	}
}

func TestTeacherPassHasNoBlockingOptionalFailuresAndErrorRemainsTechnical(t *testing.T) {
	stages := []domain.ValidationStage{{StageID: "optional", Required: false, Outcome: "FAIL", Issues: []domain.ValidationIssue{{Code: "OPTIONAL", Message: "PRIVATE_CANARY"}}}}
	for _, outcome := range []domain.ValidationOutcome{domain.OutcomePass, domain.OutcomeError} {
		t.Run(string(outcome), func(t *testing.T) {
			runtime, repository := teacherFeedbackFixture(outcome, stages)
			result, err := runtime.TeacherValidation(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, repository.instance.StudentID)
			if err != nil || !result.Available || result.TeacherExplanation == nil {
				t.Fatalf("safe result unavailable: %+v %v", result, err)
			}
			explanation := result.TeacherExplanation
			if outcome == domain.OutcomePass {
				if !*result.Passed || len(explanation.BlockingIssues) != 0 || explanation.Truncated {
					t.Fatal("optional FAIL became a blocking PASS issue")
				}
			} else if *result.Passed || len(explanation.BlockingIssues) != 1 || explanation.BlockingIssues[0].Code != "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE" || explanation.BlockingIssues[0].Message != domain.SafeTechnicalIssueMessage || explanation.BlockingIssues[0].StageID != "" {
				t.Fatalf("technical ERROR invented learner failure: %+v", explanation)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestTeacherLegacyPendingAndForeignCorrelationFailClosed(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"legacy", "pending", "different summary", "owner", "instance", "revision", "snapshot", "different submission"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			runtime, repository := teacherFeedbackFixture(domain.OutcomeFail, []domain.ValidationStage{{StageID: "html", Required: true, Outcome: "FAIL", Issues: []domain.ValidationIssue{{Code: "MISSING"}}}})
			switch mode {
			case "legacy":
				repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0].SafeSummary = nil
			case "pending":
				repository.submission.ValidationRuns = append(repository.submission.ValidationRuns, domain.ValidationRun{ID: "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000022", Status: domain.ValidationRunPending})
			case "different summary":
				repository.submission.ValidationRuns[0].SafeSummary.ValidationRunID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000023"
			case "owner":
				repository.submission.StudentID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000024"
			case "instance":
				repository.submission.TaskInstanceID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000025"
			case "revision":
				repository.submission.RevisionDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("d", 64)
			case "snapshot":
				repository.submission.Snapshot.WorkspaceDigest = "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("e", 64)
			case "different submission":
				repository.submission.ID = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000026"
			}
			result, err := runtime.TeacherValidation(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, repository.instance.StudentID)
			if mode == "legacy" || mode == "pending" || mode == "different summary" {
				if err != nil || result.Available || result.Passed != nil || result.TeacherExplanation != nil {
					t.Fatalf("fabricated unavailable explanation: %+v %v", result, err)
				}
				current, contextErr := runtime.TeacherContext(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, repository.instance.StudentID)
				if contextErr != nil || current.Validation.Available || current.Validation.StageCount != 0 || current.Validation.ErrorCount != 0 {
					t.Fatalf("stale Teacher counts: %+v %v", current.Validation, contextErr)
				}
			} else if err == nil {
				t.Fatal("foreign/mismatched submission accepted")
			}
			if _, err := runtime.TeacherValidation(context.Background(), repository.instance.ID, "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000099"); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("foreign student accepted")
			}
		})
	}
}
